searchText: There's also ideas like https://ethresear.ch/t/make-eip-1559-more-like-an-amm-curve/9082 I need some help understanding the effect of EIP 2200 after the EIP 3529 update: "If the original value is zero, the current value is nonzero, and the new value is zero, add SSTORE_SET_GAS - SLOAD_GAS (currently 19,900) gas to the refund counter" I understand it as: the current value refers to the value during transaction execution and the new value is the final value after the transaction execution... Does that mean if I update a storage slot from zero to a non zero value and later update it back to a zero value in the same transaction I'm eligible for the SSTORE_SET_GAS - SLOAD_GAS (currently 19,900) gas refund per storage slot used?

Does that mean if I update a storage slot from zero to a non zero value and later update it back to a zero value in the same transaction I'm eligible for the SSTORE_SET_GAS - SLOAD_GAS (currently 19,900) gas refund per storage slot used?
